questions.stem: Which renewable energy resource relies on the gravitational pull of the Moon?
questions.explanation: Tidal energy relies on the gravitational pull of the Moon (and to a lesser extent the Sun) which causes regular rises and falls of sea levels. This predictable movement of water can be used to generate electricity.

questions.stem: What is a major disadvantage of most renewable energy resources?

options.text: They are often intermittent and weather-dependent

questions.explanation: Many renewable resources like solar and wind are intermittent - they depend on weather conditions and cannot generate electricity on demand. This is a major challenge for energy grids that need reliable, constant power supplies.
